# CATHETER ASSOCIATED URINARY TRACT INFECTION

# Rule out obstruction.

When patients who require parenteral therapy are afebrile, clinically stable,

and can take oral medication, convert to oral therapy based on the

identification and susceptibility of the isolate.

# Duration

Treat for 5 days with fluoroquinolones or 7 days with non-fluoroquinolone

antibiotics.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Empirical treatment

# PO therapy options

Preferred:

[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI for 7 days](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

< OR >

[Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO q12h R,O, CrCl =/>30mL/min, for 7 days](psozid-nitrofurantoin-sa-7ds-100-mg-po-bid)

*Avoid nitrofurantoin in the third trimester

*Not for infections outside of the bladder

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-nitrofurantoin-sa-7ds-100-mg-po-bid)

Primary alternatives:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-7ds-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-7ds-po-bid)

< OR >

[Fosfomycin 3 gm sachet PO every other day M x 3 doses](psozid-fosfomycin-3gm-po-qotherday-for-3doses)

*Not for infections outside of the bladder

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-fosfomycin-3gm-po-qotherday-for-3doses)

< OR >

[Cefpodoxime 400 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-cefpodoxime-400mg-po-bid-7ds)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-cefpodoxime-400mg-po-bid-7ds)

Secondary alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h R,DI for 5 days](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-5ds-500mg-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciprofloxacin-5ds-500mg-po-bid)

# IV therapy options

Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Treatment for specific pathogens based on susceptibilities

# Enterobacteria including E. coli, Klebsiella, and Proteus

Preferred:

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-7days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-7days)

Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI for 7 days](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

# Staphylococcus aureus

S. aureus is an uncommon urinary tract pathogen and presence in the urine may be

due to hematogenous seeding from another site. Blood cultures are indicated to

rule out bacteremia in patients who have S. aureus isolated from the urine.

Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.

# Pseudomonas

[Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q12h R,DI for 5 days](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid-5ds)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid-5ds)

# Enterococcus

Preferred:

[Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO q8h R for 7 days](psozid2-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-7days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-7days)

Alternatives:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Fosfomycin 3 gm sachet PO every other day M x 3 doses](psozid-fosfomycin-3gm-po-qotherday-for-3doses)

*Not for infections outside of the bladder

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-fosfomycin-3gm-po-qotherday-for-3doses)

< OR >

[Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO q12h R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min, for 7 days](psozid-nitrofurantoin-sa-7ds-100-mg-po-bid)

*Avoid nitrofurantoin in the third trimester

*Not for infections outside of the bladder

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-nitrofurantoin-sa-7ds-100-mg-po-bid)
